resources.string: Your own notes, kept on this phone only

Only you can read this journal. Entries stay on this phone: they are not synced, not backed up and never shared with your co-parent. Uninstalling the app, or signing in to a different account on this phone, deletes them. You can choose to add entries to an export yourself.
